name: Sprinix Typing Test
author: Sprinix Technolabs

sections.description:
This is a powerful and user-friendly WordPress plugin that helps users assess and improve their typing speed and accuracy.

Key Features:

  • Multi-Language Support – Test your typing in English and Hindi (Mangal font support)
  • Real-Time WPM Calculation – Accurate Words Per Minute tracking
  • Accuracy Tracking – Detailed accuracy percentage calculation
  • Two Test Modes – Practice and Timed modes
  • Customizable Paragraphs – Admin can add custom typing paragraphs
  • User History – Track all your previous typing test results
  • Admin Dashboard – Comprehensive results management interface
  • Beautiful UI – Modern, responsive design for all devices
  • Easy Integration – Simple shortcode-based implementation

Shortcodes Included:

  • [typing_test_setup] – Language selection page
  • [typing_test language="english"] – English typing test
  • [typing_test language="hindi"] – Hindi typing test
  • [typing_history] – View your personal typing test history

Usage

After activation, you can use the plugin in three ways:

1. Language Selection Page

[typing_test_setup]

This displays English and Hindi language buttons for users to select their preferred language.

2. English Typing Test

[typing_test language="english"]

Displays the typing test interface in English.

3. Hindi Typing Test

[typing_test language="hindi"]

Displays the typing test interface in Hindi (supports Mangal font).

4. User History

[typing_history]

Allows logged-in users to view all their previous typing test results with detailed statistics.

Admin Features

  • Dashboard → Typing Test → Add Paragraphs – Add new typing paragraphs
  • Dashboard → Typing Test → Results – View and manage all user results
  • Dashboard → Typing Test → Guide – Comprehensive documentation

Add compatibility line

Compatible with most WordPress themes and plugins.

Add Performance section

Lightweight plugin with no external dependencies and optimized for fast loading.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/sprinix-typing-test/

Credits

Developed with care for WordPress community.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later. You are free to use, modify, and distribute it according to the license terms.

Privacy Policy

Sprinix Typing Test stores user typing test results (WPM, accuracy, test date) in the WordPress database. This data is only visible to:
– The user who took the test
– Administrators

No data is sent to external services. User data is never shared with third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sprinix-typing-test folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Create new pages and add the shortcodes where you want the typing test to appear
  4. Go to ‘Typing Test’ menu to add custom paragraphs or view results

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Extract the ZIP file
  3. Upload the sprinix-typing-test folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  4. Activate in WordPress admin

Via WordPress Admin

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Sprinix Typing Test”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes! Sprinix Typing Test is designed to work with all WordPress themes. It uses standard WordPress hooks and doesn’t conflict with existing functionality.

Can users see other users’ results?

No, users can only see their own typing history. Admin can view all results in the dashboard to manage data.

What fonts does it support?

The plugin supports all standard web fonts. Hindi typing tests use the Mangal font by default, but you can customize this.

Can I add custom paragraphs?

Yes! You can add custom paragraphs for typing tests through the admin menu under Typing Test → Add Paragraphs.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works great on tablets and smartphones.

How is user data stored?

User typing test results are stored securely in WordPress database. The plugin follows WordPress security standards.

What languages are supported?

Current version supports:
– English (US/UK)
– Hindi (Devanagari script)

More languages can be added in future versions.

Is there any JavaScript dependency?

The plugin uses vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery dependency) and CSS3 for a light, fast experience.

Can I delete user results?

Yes, admin can delete individual or bulk user results from the Results dashboard.

Does it support custom paragraphs upload?

Yes, there’s a dedicated upload interface where users can upload custom text for typing tests.
